rows.text: stores the address `01CB2498` at qword `[rcx]`; when dword `rcx+8` is non-zero it makes the call at `00793410` + 0x3C with qword `rcx+0x10` if that qword is non-null and bit 31 of the dword is clear, then zeroes qword `+0x10` and dword `+8`; it then makes the call at + 0x5E (same callee) with qword `+0x10` when bit 31 of dword `+8` is clear and that qword is non-null (reachable only when the dword was 0 on entry), and finally zeroes qword `+0x10` and dword `+8` again

notes: 00793410: the bit-31 test is shr 0x1f / not / test al,1, i.e. the call runs only when bit 31 is clear. Entered from 007933C0 by a jmp (tail call), as the pack lists.
